_comment: US EPA GHG Emission Factors Hub 2025 — modal_default freight rows.
Primary source: 'Emission Factors for Greenhouse Gas Inventories' (EPA), Jan 2025 hub release.
https://www.epa.gov/system/files/documents/2025-01/ghg-emission-factors-hub-2025.pdf
Table 8 'Scope 3 Category 4: Upstream Transportation and Distribution and Category 9:
Downstream Transportation and Distribution' — the short-ton-mile freight rows.
PROVENANCE (label per CLAUDE.md rule 14): [CONFIRMED] — Table 8's exact row text was read directly
from the primary EPA PDF via two independent fetches in the authoring session, which agreed:
'Medium- and Heavy-Duty Truck 0.186 0.0016 0.0054 short ton-mile'
'Rail                        0.021 0.0016 0.0005 short ton-mile'
(columns: CO2 kg/unit, CH4 g/unit, N2O g/unit). Table 2 of the same PDF independently confirmed
the fuel-based CO2 factors this session cross-checked against (diesel 10.21 kg CO2/gallon,
gasoline 8.78 kg CO2/gallon), and a third-party republication of the same hub
(github.com/starrybodies/ghg-calculator, epa_hub/v2025.json) reproduces those same two numbers
exactly — independent corroboration, not the sole source.
UNIT CONVERSION AND CO2e AGGREGATION — done BY US, not published by EPA (hence derivation:
'calculated' below, not 'observed'). EPA Table 8 states its rows in kg CO2 / g CH4 / g N2O per
short ton-mile; it does not publish a tonne.km figure and does not state which GWP set
aggregates the three gases into one CO2e number (Table 8 has no CO2e column — only a Table 9
note, about WASTE factors, names AR4). Method, versioned as 'epa-2025-table8-tkm-ar5-v1':
1. 1 short ton-mile = 0.90718474 t x 1.609344 km = 1.4599723182... tonne.km (exact SI/US
customary conversion constants; not sourced from EPA).
2. CH4 and N2O converted g -> kg (/1000), all three species divided by the tonne.km factor
above to land on kg / tonne.km.
3. ttw_co2e = co2_fossil + ch4_kg*28 + n2o_kg*265 (IPCC AR5 GWP-100 factors for CH4/N2O —
our choice, not EPA's; recorded as gwp_basis 'AR5_GWP100' so a later reviewer can recompute
under AR6 if that is later preferred).
Recomputed once more independently while authoring this fixture; both runs agreed to the
precision stored below.
as_at_date / valid_from: 2025-01-01 — the EPA hub's 2025-01 publication path; EPA does not print
an exact day-of-month release date on the document itself.

Converted to kg/tonne.km and aggregated to CO2e under AR5 GWP100 by method_version epa-2025-table8-tkm-ar5-v1 (see fixture-level _comment for the exact steps).
